title: How to center a div
content: To center a `<div>` horizontally, you can use CSS. There are multiple ways to achieve center alignment. Here are a few common methods: 1. Using `margin: auto;`: ```css div { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; } ``` 2. Using `text-align: center;` on the parent container: ```css .parent-container { text-align: center; } .parent-container div { display: inline-block; } ``` 3. Using flexbox: ```css .parent-container { display: flex; justify-content: center; } ``` 4. Using CSS Grid: ```css .parent-container { display: grid; place-items: center; } ``` Choose the method that best fits your layout and apply the CSS to the appropriate selector or class. Remember to adjust the CSS selector or class name according to your specific HTML structure.
